title: FlyDubai plane attack by co-pilot was an attempted 'terrorist' act, UAE says
summary_full: The FlyDubai co-pilot attacked the pilot inside the cockpit with a crash axe and attempted to take control of the aircraft, the UAE prosecutor general said.
